definitions: Holding as much moisture or liquid as possible; thoroughly wet.
Denoting fats and fatty acids in which the hydrocarbon chains have only single bonds.
Having absorbed or dissolved the maximum amount of a substance.
Used to describe a colour that is very strong and not mixed with any white or grey.
examples: The ground was saturated after the heavy rain.
Butter contains a lot of saturated fat.
The solution was saturated with salt.
The painting used vibrant, saturated colours.
